name: firmware-release-gate
displayName: Firmware Release Gate for sdkconfig and prj.conf
description: Finds the build-config lines that ship an ESP-IDF or Zephyr device with secure boot off, a debug port open, unsigned images or plaintext OTA.

commands.title: List the rules that ship inside
Audit every config in the workspace

firmware-release-gate.min_severity.description: Hide findings below this severity (info | warn | error)

firmware-release-gate.report_format.description: Default format for the exported report (csv | json | html)

firmware-release-gate.max_files.description: Maximum number of files to read in a workspace audit

firmware-release-gate.exclude_glob.description: Paths to skip in a workspace audit (glob)

firmware-release-gate.extraRules.description: Extra rules of your own, checked alongside the ones that ship inside.
